dataSource: LOGIS ePermits (epermits.logis.org) — Building, Plumbing, Mechanical, Electrical, and Fire permit records
notes: Deep coverage across all major permit systems — Building, Plumbing, Mechanical, Electrical, and Fire — matched by address.
